ABSOLUTE STYLE LOCK (non-negotiable — this is the single most important constraint):

This is a 2D FLAT-SHADED CARTOON ANIMATION in the EXACT style of the attached reference image (Bamboo the panda). The reference image defines the character AND the rendering style for every single frame of this video. The whole clip must look like the reference came to life — NOT a 3D model inspired by it, NOT a Pixar version of it, NOT a CGI rendering of it.

STYLE IS 2D HAND-DRAWN CARTOON ANIMATION:
- Flat base colors with smooth soft airbrushed gradient shading (2-3 shade steps max).
- Subject has a clean confident silhouette like a sticker, NOT a volumetric 3D form.
- Shading is painted FLAT onto the shapes, not raytraced or physically simulated.
- Think Cartoon Saloon / Headspace animated ads / Duolingo Push Notifications — flat 2D motion graphics, NOT Pixar, NOT DreamWorks, NOT Blender/Maya 3D.

ABSOLUTELY FORBIDDEN (reject on sight — these ruined the previous attempt):
- 3D rendering, CGI, Pixar-style volumetric shading, plastic-looking surfaces, raytraced lighting.
- Orange or peach or tan or beige backgrounds — the backdrop must be #F7EFE2 bone.
- Green glass teapots — the teapot must be AMBER #C9872A ceramic with a darker forest-green rim.
- Chamomile flowers larger than Bamboo's head — ingredients are SMALL, smaller than one of his ears.
- Any 3D ambient occlusion, global illumination, or physically-based rendering tells.
- The teapot cutting off Bamboo's body from the viewer — the teapot sits on an invisible surface BESIDE or just in front of Bamboo, not eclipsing him.

SCENE (8 seconds, 9:16 portrait):

0.0-1.5s: Open on Bamboo standing centered on a soft bone #F7EFE2 background (with a very subtle #7B9467 sage radial vignette at the edges). He looks directly at camera, same chibi proportions and face as the reference image. An amber #C9872A ceramic teapot (short squat round shape with forest-green rim) sits on an invisible surface directly in front of him, small enough that his full body is visible above and behind it. Bamboo smiles warmly.

1.5-2.5s: Bamboo gently raises both paws toward the sky, inviting the viewer in. Smooth 2D motion-graphics easing.

2.5-5.5s: Three small ingredients drift down from the top of the frame, one at a time: a peppermint sprig (1.5s mark), a chamomile flower (3.5s mark), a few lavender buds (4.5s mark). Each ingredient is SMALL — about the size of one of Bamboo's ears. Each drifts with a gentle feather-wobble and settles INTO the teapot's open top. Each landing produces a tiny brief 'poof' of 3-4 golden pixel-sparkles that fade within 0.3 seconds (gentle + charming — NOT a particle explosion, NOT glitter).

5.5-6.5s: Bamboo places both paws on the teapot lid.

6.5-7.5s: A thin amber-tinted steam ribbon curls up from the teapot spout in a graceful S-curve, arcing above Bamboo's head.

7.5-8.0s: Bamboo's eyes close into happy crescents; his smile widens slightly. Hold.

CAMERA: Absolutely locked-off. No pan, no zoom, no push-in, no dolly. The frame never moves.

PALETTE (strict): only sage #7B9467, forest #3F5E4A, bone #F7EFE2, amber #C9872A, ember #C0522F, charcoal #2A2A2A. NO other hues. NO orange. NO peach. NO tan.

MOTION: Smooth 24fps 2D animation. Think After Effects keyframe tweens, not frame-by-frame hand-drawn. Gentle ease-in-out on every motion.

AUDIO: Barely-there. One soft pour/steam sound around 6.5s. Otherwise silence.

NO text, NO watermark, NO logo, NO UI, NO other characters, NO hands, NO checkerboard patterns, NO banners.

Final check: if the output looks like a 3D Pixar character, it is WRONG. The character and entire scene must look like the attached 2D reference image, animated.
